jobs.occupation: Dangerous Goods Expert (all genders) (full-time / part-time) (Chemiker/in)
jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.Your role:In this pivotal role, you will shape the future of safe and compliant product transport across a broad global life science portfolio, driving regulatory excellence at scale. You will assess dangerous goods classifications, determine packaging requirements and transport restrictions, and develop compliant solutions in close collaboration with cross functional teams. Beyond day-to-day advisory work, you will lead the continuous improvement, streamlining, and automation of global dangerous goods processes, combining deep technical expertise with a forward-looking mindset to increase both compliance and operational efficiency. Whether working within a team  or steering dedicated projects, you will act as a trusted expert and mentor, influencing technical direction and contributing to the strategic development of the function.This position is limited to 2 years.Who you are:- You hold a minimum master’s degree in chemistry or a related field.- You have a sound knowledge of dangerous goods transport and professional expertise in DG classification (DOT, RID/ADR, IATA, IMO, PK1 certification) as well as DG Safety Advisor training.- You have proven experience with SAP EHSM and common analytic tools.- You have proven experience in programming (e.g. Python, JAVA, KNIME).- You have strong project management and communication skills.- You have excellent German and English skills - C Level.What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.occupation: Project Engineer (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description: VetterTec is an innovative company headquartered in Kassel, Germany, with more than 95 years of experience in the development and manufacturing of machinery and systems for industrial drying and dewatering, particularly for the food processing industry. With a team of more than 160 employees across six locations and an international sales share exceeding 80%, we offer an exciting and dynamic working environment.To support our continued growth, we are looking for a Project Engineer who is passionate about driving technically demanding projects to success.As a Project Engineer, you take ownership of projects from kick-off through final handover, both technically and organizationally. Acting as the customer's main point of contact, you work closely with Technical Engineering, Process Engineering, Procurement, and site teams to ensure successful project execution. This role is ideal for someone who leads through technical expertise and practical experience, with a strong focus on technical project responsibility rather than pure project coordination.Your Responsibilities:- Full project ownership from order handover to technical and commercial handover (TOC) - budget, schedule, risk and scope- Single point of contact for the customer throughout the project- Functional leadership of the core project team - holding the team's capacity together and keeping the project moving as one- Technical judgment: understanding the equipment and the process well enough to challenge assumptions and demand the right decisions at the right time- On-site presence at the milestones that matter — project kick-off, construction start, mechanical and electrical completion, commissioning start, and the final performance run (Leistungsfahrt) through handover- Presence at key suppliers for the acceptance (FAT) of critical components- Running the team's agile rhythm - weekly syncs, a shared task board, rolling short-term planning, and visualizing progress - and adjusting quickly when the project needs it- Integrating the contributions of Technical Engineering, Process Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Installation and Commissioning into one coherent project, without replacing any of themWhat You Bring:- Professional experience in international plant or equipment engineering (Anlagenbau), ideally with process or industrial equipment- A hands-on, practical mindset — someone who has stood on a shop floor or a construction site, not only in front of a screen; we weigh practical experience over theoretical credentials- A mechanical engineering background as a Techniker (completed apprenticeship plus Techniker) or a comparable practical qualification (Bachelor's / FH degree)- Experience in vessel and plant construction (Anlagen- und Behälterbau) - manufacturing methods and welding processes- Project management capability - comfortable owning budget, schedule and risk - with a technical center of gravity- Business-fluent English (must-have); German is a plus, not a requirement- Willingness to travel internationally, including assignments of around two weeks at a time- Comfortable leading a team with lightweight agile practices - task boards, short review cycles, rolling planning - rather than heavyweight process- Professional or Senior level - we are hiring at bothHow We Work:- Projects follow a clear phase structure, but day to day we work in short cycles — weekly team syncs, a shared task board, and rolling four-to-six-week planning alongside the overall schedule- Remote work is possible for this role, with on-site presence expected for supplier acceptances of key components and for construction and site activities- You don't need to be based in Germany- Onboarding starts in the office; afterwards, your working pattern is by arrangement- A relaxed, direct working atmosphere — we'd rather solve a problem in the team meeting than escalate itWhat We Offer:- Real ownership of international projects from kick-off through commissioning and final handover- A technically challenging role with a high level of responsibility and the opportunity to shape Project Engineering at VetterTec- A collaborative, solution-oriented culture with short decision-making processes- 30 days of annual leave, attractive working conditions, and a competitive compensation package- Comprehensive employee benefits, including bike leasing, subsidized public transportation, Corporate Benefits, and additional company benefits- Extensive personal and professional development opportunities in an international environment﻿Please don't spend time writing a cover letter. Instead, send us a brief project portfolio describing a project you have taken from the initial phase through execution and final handover, highlighting your responsibilities, key challenges, and achieved results.**Take Your Opportunity - **Join us and actively contribute to the continued growth and development of our company. Together, we strive to inspire our employees and customers through innovative technology, modern structures, and sustainable growthTogether Towards the Future. Are You Ready to Join Us?If you have any questions regarding this position, please contact Ms. Jasmin Hohmann at +49 561 50019-201.Convince Us. We Look Forward to Getting to Know You!Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Projektmanagement, Anlagenbau, Fertigungstechnik, Schweißtechnik

jobs.occupation: Electronics Engineer (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description: The Max Planck Institute for Solar System Research (MPS) in Göttingen is one of the world's leading research institutions in the fields of solar physics and planetary research, with approximately 300 employees. The interdisciplinary research focus lies in the investigation of the development, diversity, and dynamics of planets, moons, small bodies, the sun, and solar-like stars. MPS develops and operates scientific instruments for current and future space missions (e.g., ESA, NASA) and conducts cosmochemical laboratory investigations of meteorites as well as numerical modeling on state-of-the-art supercomputers.For the development of a plasma spectrometer to be flown on the ESA M7-Mission "Plasma Observatory" PMO, the institute is looking for aElectronics Engineer (m/f/d)This position is subject to financing that has not yet been confirmed. As an electronics engineer, you will work as part of a team on the development of electronics hardware for use in space, as well as its testing, qualification, and documentation. In this role, you will work closely with the project team and external partners both in Germany and abroad.Your Tasks- Design, implementation, and test of space-qualified analog and digital circuits electronics- Develop high-voltage control for particle Instrument and TOF mass-spectrometer- Contribute to the development and performance of environmental test procedures for the electronics and the plasma spectrometer- Contribute to the calibration and the operation of a plasma spectrometer instrumentYour Qualification- Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering- Extensive knowledge of analog and digital circuit design- Experience in the independent development of space-qualified electronics (analog/digital) in accordance with ESA standards- Experience in the development, synthesis, and testing of FPGAs (e.g., Microsemi RTAX or Xilinx Ultrascale)- Strong understanding of physics and engineering- Willingness to work in cleanrooms and to comply with the required regulations- Willingness to travel internationallyYou should have• Good hands-on skills for electronics assembly and measurement• High motivation, problem solving attitude, be a continuous learner, and      team player• Experience in space projects (ESA, NASA, etc.) is of advantage• Strong communication skills• Fluency in English• Good knowledge of the German languageOur Offer•  onboarding, professional development and further training opportunities• Diverse and varied tasks in an international workenvironment• Remuneration according to TVöDBund, based on qualifications and experience, annual bonus and additional pension scheme (VBL)• 30 days of vacation plus 4 additional days off• Full-time and part-time employment; flexible working time and possibility of mobile work• Cooperation with local bilingual Montessori child care center• public transport connection• Corporate health managementAdditional Information- The full-time position can be filled starting 4 Jan 2027 or later. Employment is initially limited in time until end of 2030 with a possible extension if the project will be continued and if funding will be available- The position is rated in acccordance to public service act (TVöD-Bund) as EG 13- Temporary teleworking can be negotiated- Social security benefits are in accordance with the public service regulations- End date for application is 31 October 2026As a scientific institution, the Max Planck Institute for Solar System Research offers an attractive international and sophisticated environment with the possibility of implementing one's own ideas and concepts. Moreover, we offer opportunities to reconcile work and family as well as health promotion.We look forward to receiving your informative application documents (cover letter, CV, certificates, training and employers' references (if available)). Please submit these via the digital application portal (https://www.mps.mpg.de/career/jobs (https://www.mps.mpg.de/career/jobs) ). Furthermore, the Max Planck Society seeks to increase the number of women in those areas where they are underrepresented and therefore explicitly encourages women to apply. The Max Planck Society is committed to increasing the number of individuals with disabilities in its workforce and therefore encourages applications from such qualified individuals.Website of the Institute https://www.mps.mpg.de/en (https://www.mps.mpg.de/)

The role combines strong Business Analysis capabilities with hands-on Salesforce configuration knowledge. collaborate with developers for Apex, Lightning Web Components, or other coded solutions, as software development is outside the role.Customer Service Process and Platform Ownership Support- Serve as functional expert for Customer Service processes and Service Cloud, including case lifecycle, inquiries, interaction history, routing and queues, service channels, knowledge, entitlements and milestones, templates, automation, and reporting.- Drive consistent end-to-end processes and data flows across Customer Service, Sales, Marketing, Technical Service, and connected systems; evolve reusable global templates while enabling justified, controlled localization.- Identify improvements to agent productivity, first-contact resolution, response quality, process transparency, and customer experience.- Support the responsible evaluation and adoption of AI-enabled and automation capabilities, including Agentforce where applicable.Testing, Release, and Deployment Support- Define test scenarios and expected results; prepare and execute functional testing and support integration, end-to-end, regression, and user acceptance testing.- Triage defects, clarify expected behavior, support root-cause analysis, and coordinate resolution with the appropriate teams.- Support release planning, readiness, deployment preparation, release notes, post-deployment validation, and hypercare; help prioritize incidents, defects, process gaps, and enhancements.Stakeholder Collaboration and Enablement- Build trusted relationships with global and local Customer Service stakeholders; communicate effectively with business and technical audiences and facilitate decisions by clearly presenting options, trade-offs, impacts, recommendations, and open points.- Guide local CRM specialists on market adoption, training, end-user support, and complex or escalated topics.- Create or support process documentation, user guidance, release communications, training materials, and enablement concepts.- Contribute to cross-regional communities of practice and promote consistent Business Analysis and Salesforce configuration standards.Data, Reporting, and Operational Support- Ensure the quality, consistency, integrity, and appropriate use of Customer Service and cross-stream Platform data, including cases, interactions, accounts, contacts, knowledge, entitlements, and service history.- Define reporting requirements and create or support reports and dashboards for operational management, service performance, adoption tracking, and continuous improvement.- Analyze incidents, user feedback, process performance, and platform usage to identify improvements;
